company.tooldescription: Fill in the form describing a company that hires, for the signed-in person to check and save on joblist. The website domain identifies the company.

params.url: The company's own website, e.g. https://acme.org (not a job board).
params.name: The company's name.
params.description: A short, factual description of what the company does.
params.provider: The job board provider hosting the company's open jobs, if any.
params.boardId: The company's id at the job board provider, e.g. 'acme' in https://jobs.lever.co/acme.
params.careersUrl: The company's careers page, when its jobs are not on a known provider. A job board link also works.
params.tags: Comma-separated lowercase tags, e.g. 'climate, open-source, coop'.
params.links: Another public page of the company (its Bluesky or LinkedIn profile, Wikipedia…).

job.tooldescription: Fill in a job offer for the signed-in person to check and post on joblist, from their own account. The company must already be chosen on the page. Applications go to the poster directly, never through joblist.

params.title: The job title, e.g. 'Frontend engineer'.
params.description: The offer as plain text: the job, who they look for, salary if known.
params.remote: Where the work happens: onsite, hybrid or remote.
params.employment: The kind of contract: full-time, part-time, contract, internship or volunteer.
params.offerUrl: Link to the full offer on the company's site, if there is one.
params.applyTo: Where to apply: an application form link (https://…) or an email address.
params.bluesky: Whether candidates may apply by Bluesky direct message to the poster.
params.days: How many days to show the offer, from 1 to 120 (default 60).

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the companies described on joblist by name, domain, tag or place. Returns up to 20 companies with their website, tags, locations, job board and joblist page.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'berlin climate' or 'ableton'.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs at companies on joblist (job boards as of the last snapshot, refreshed every few hours, and offers posted on joblist). Returns up to 20 jobs, newest first, with title, company, location, pay when known and link to apply.

query.description: Words in the job title, department or company name, e.g. 'frontend engineer'.

place.description: A city or country the job location must mention, e.g. 'Berlin'.

remote.description: Only jobs done remotely. With a place: remote jobs open to that place, or naming no limit.

anywhere.description: Only remote jobs that name no country or region they are limited to.

pay.description: Only jobs whose job board says what they pay (salary: min, max, currency, period).
